title: George's ideas about music
summary: He liked all kinds of music, jazz was his love, and he simply wanted to play his horn well.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Did he ever talk about music or saying anything about his ideas about music or anything like that?

His ideas about music. Well, he liked music of all types. He didn't down any type music. But jazz was his love. All he wanted to do was to play and to play well. But for the same, he had any ideas about it. If he did, he didn't mention it. He just wanted to play his horn because he loved playing his horn and he enjoyed it very much.
